programme.desc: The second programme focuses on the 18th century, a period that heralded the greatest blossoming of Scottish artistry in its history. programme.desc: S2 E12 — The 'Q' Word Three-month-old Jaziah has been rushed to resus with breathing difficulties. He's severely underweight and has an enlarged liver. Meanwhile, in paediatric A&E, 18-month-old Charlie's mum Kerry is waiting for urine test results that could explain why he's been feeling unwell for five days. Ronald, who's 81, has been brought to King's by his daughter Tracey. He's had a suspected stroke, which is affecting his speech.

Usually a lively young girl, she can't remember what day it is or her surname. She doesn't even recognise her own mum. Treating Tino is consultant Liz, but despite her years of experience, even she isn't initially certain what's wrong with Tino.
programme.title: 24 Hours in A&E

programme.desc: S2 E1 — Episode 1 The Heli-Medics battle to keep 48-year-old Paul alive as he suffers a series of heart attacks. Roger's emergency stop halts his day at a scooter rally. In Cumbria, there is a dramatic mountainside rescue for seriously injured cyclist Nick.
programme.title: Emergency Helicopter Medics

programme.title: Four in a Bed

programme.title: The Dog House

programme.desc: S01 E02 — Spring Onion Chicken Curry and Sausage Broccoli Pizza Jamie elevates asparagus spears for a fishy feat, makes spring onions the star of the show in his spicy green chicken curry and gives purple sprouting broccoli an Italian-inspired makeover.
programme.title: Jamie Oliver: Seasons

programme.desc: S01 E05 — Buddy's Strawberry Rice Pudding and Summer Tomato Chicken Bake Jamie cooks a chicken sheet pan dinner with early tomatoes, potatoes and chorizo. Buddy helps pick strawberries for quick jam rice pudding. The summer feast ends with spicy shrimp skewers with homegrown chillies and a refreshing cucumber gazpacho.
programme.title: Jamie Oliver: Seasons

programme.desc: S01 E06 — Endless Summer: From Grilled Panzanella Salad to Sour Cherry Tart Jamie ends summer with crispy duck in a rich plum sauce & roast potatoes. Grilled peppers star in panzanella. Garden zucchini become Mediterranean rice. Sweet finale: sour cherry frangipane with crème fraîche.
programme.title: Jamie Oliver: Seasons

programme.desc: S01 E08 — Autumn's Harvest: Roast Chicken and Tarte Tatin Jamie cooks a roast chicken with eggplant, bakes feta with figs & prosciutto, and creates a runner bean stew with fish. He shares tips for storing berries and chiles, finishing with a stunning pear tarte tatin.
programme.title: Jamie Oliver: Seasons

programme.desc: S01 E09 — Autumn's Last Bites: Squash Tagliatelle and Blackberry Cobbler Jamie wraps up autumn with cheesy squash tagliatelle, a mushroom curry with crispy ginger rice, and celeriac rémoulade. He forages for blackberries to make a cobbler, the perfect end to a crisp autumn day.
programme.title: Jamie Oliver: Seasons

programme.desc: S10 E03 — Chicken Pizza Ditch the dough. Chef Frankie Celenza makes a protein-packed pizza the whole family will love. This is chicken pizza like you've never tried at home - until now.
programme.title: Struggle Meals

programme.desc: S10 E13 — Whole Chicken Paprikash Chef Frankie Celenza stretches one whole chicken and a pack of ramen to make a rich and warm Chicken Paprikash dish, swapping egg noodles for buttered ramen and using the seasoning packet to boost the sauce.
programme.title: Struggle Meals

programme.desc: S10 E12 — Fancy Fish Filet Sandwich Chef Frankie Celenza levels up a drive-thru classic fish filet sandwich with ultra-crispy fried cod, homemade tartar sauce and pimento cheese. Plus, five reasons not to toss your leftover pickle brine.
programme.title: Struggle Meals

programme.desc: S10 E10 — Pub-Style Pie A comforting pub classic made easy. Chef Frankie Celenza turns inexpensive chuck roast and rich stout beer into a hearty British Beef and Ale Pie with a waterproof hot water crust. Plus, how to cook once for comfort food twice.
programme.title: Struggle Meals

programme.desc: S10 E09 — Ramen Croutons and Napa Cabbage Chef Frankie Celenza elevates a packet of ramen for a hearty yet dainty salad. The dish features crispy croutons atop a crunchy napa cabbage with fruit, nuts and leftover chicken. Plus, a reminder to make your own salad dressing. You can do it!
programme.title: Struggle Meals

programme.desc: S10 E06 — Meatloaf More Than Once Chef Frankie Celenza turns 2 lbs of ground beef into a moist meatloaf and pan-seared meatloaf burgers with slaw. Plus, a tip on storing burgers that your future self will thank you for.
programme.title: Struggle Meals

programme.desc: S10 E01 — BEC for One, For Many Make the perfect bacon, egg and cheese sandwich for yourself or for a crowd with Chef Frankie Celenza's tips on homemade condiments and the secret to crispy bacon every time.
programme.title: Struggle Meals

programme.desc: S10 E16 — Half Homemade Matzo Ball Soup Chef Frankie Celenza makes cozy, comforting Matzo Ball Soup entirely from scratch, almost. Rotisserie chicken is the struggle hero of this classic recipe, searing the skin to create rich schmaltz. Plus homemade matzo balls that float and never sink.
programme.title: Struggle Meals

programme.desc: S10 E17 — A Big Braised Chuck Roast Sandwich aka The Wichita Have you ever wondered what's the difference between a Philly Cheesesteak and a French Dip Sandwich? Chef Frankie Celenza takes a bite out of both and invents a whole new, affordable, delicious sandwich: The Wichita!
programme.title: Struggle Meals

programme.desc: S05 E04 — Mediterranean Grilled Filets and Salt Crusted Halibut Andrew Zimmern elevates California halibut, first with grilled fillets on saffron labneh with romesco and roasted cabbage. Then, he demonstrates a classic salt-crusted whole halibut, served with whole roasted cauliflower and a rich cream sauce.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S06 E03 — The Most Underrated Game Bird Goose, one of Andrew's favorite game birds, is prepared two ways: a French onion soup-style grilled breast sandwich with caramelized onions and melted cheese, and a whole bird, cured, roasted on a beer can, and served with an apple-fennel salad.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S04 E06 — Grilled Eggplant Caponata Toast and Crispy Squab Katsu Andrew Zimmern creates an elegant, seared pigeon toast crowned with a Sicilian caponata bursting with grilled eggplant, olives, and capers and a crispy pigeon katsu served with a refreshing shaved cabbage salad and punchy ginger-carrot vinaigrette.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S04 E03 — Tailgate Tacos and Bison Bolognese Chef Andrew Zimmern starts simmering a classic Italian Bolognese sauce, with ground bison, lots of red wine and tomatoes. Then, he adds marinated bison skirt steak tacos with borracho beans to the tailgate menu.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S06 E06 — Game Day Fried Squab Andrew gives squab the game-day treatment with two bold recipes: crispy Buffalo-style fried squab with blue cheese and ranch, and red chile grilled squab taquitos with green tomatillo salsa, cotija and crema.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S06 E04 — How to Cook a Whole Pig at Home Andrew tackles suckling pig with two recipes-his take on a three-cup braise with soy, rice wine, and sesame oil, served with plancha fried rice, and a whole pig roasted over open fire and pulled for Philly-style pork sandwiches with broccoli rabe.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S05 E08 — Elk Tenderloin Tostadas and Grilled Rack of Ribs Andrew Zimmern highlights lean elk, first crafting classic Mexican tostadas with grilled tenderloin, avocado, and homemade salsa macha. Then, he grills a whole rack of elk, serving it with creamy colcannon, tarragon emulsion, and rosemary charcoal.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S03 E09 — Tuna 101: Grilled, Poached and Raw Chef Andrew Zimmern breaks down a whole tuna and serves it three ways: grilled, raw, and poached.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S05 E05 — The King of Open-Fire Paella Andrew Zimmern showcases quail two ways: classic Southern fried quail with lemon-basil aioli, and as an elevated topping for a traditional open-fire paella, complete with crispy socarrat. He proves this small bird makes an extraordinary dinner.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S04 E09 — Wild Seafood Risotto Chef Andrew Zimmern demystifies working with live sea urchin and scallops by creating a showstopping seafood risotto.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S05 E06 — Minnesota's Foraged Mushroom Feast Andrew Zimmern explores Minnesota's forests for wild mushrooms. He creates a simple grilled mushroom salad, then hand-shapes cavatelli pasta tossed with golden chanterelles, butter, garlic, thyme, and colatura. He shares foraging and cleaning tips.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S06 E10 — The Ultimate Elk Tailgate It's an elk tailgate over live fire. Andrew makes chorizo-spiced elk meatballs with queso fundido and red chile salsa, then cooks hay-smoked elk chops with charred alliums and black garlic-juniper butter.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S04 E02 — Back to Our Caveman Roots Chef Andrew Zimmern goes primal with two antelope dishes: a Greek-style whole leg roasted over the open fire with a lemony avgolemono sauce and crispy potatoes, and a simple antelope tenderloin carpaccio served with roasted tomatoes and Parmesan.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S05 E10 — Wild Boar Feast: Chorizo with Mussels and Whole Roasted Leg Wild boar takes center stage! Andrew makes chorizo with mussels, preserved lemon & white wine. Then, he slow-roasts a whole leg over fire, served Southern-style with pickled cherries, glazed onions & mustard sauce.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S06 E05 — Bison Brats & Grilled Kebabs on Flatbread Andrew butchers a whole bison leg before diving in to grinding meat for bison brats, grilling them up and topping with homemade spicy mustard. Then, he grills Middle Eastern-inspired kebabs to serve over flatbread for a feast built for sharing.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S03 E02 — Carne Adovada Chef Andrew Zimmern prepares Carne Adovada.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S06 E01 — The Best Fish You're Not Eating Andrew takes on "little fish, big fish," cooking grilled whole small fish over Japanese charcoal with sesame spinach, and a larger fish in a bold puttanesca-style dish. Simple techniques, big flavor, and a case for eating lower on the food chain.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S05 E07 — Grilled Clams Casino and Garlicky Clam Pizza Andrew Zimmern celebrates cherrystone clams with two show-stopping recipes. He prepares classic grilled clams casino with pancetta, then pushes boundaries with an innovative grilled pizza topped with clams, garlic, chiles, and cheese.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S04 E05 — Yakitori-Style Skewers and Pheasant Flatbread Andrew butchers a whole pheasant to make yakitori-style skewers and a homemade flatbread, cucumber salad and a mango chutney.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S06 E02 — Grilled Yellowtail Collars & Filets with Miso Sauce Andrew cooks yellowtail two ways: grilled collars with a sweet, savory Filipino-inspired adobo sauce, and grilled filets with miso sauce, shiso butter, and charred vegetables. A lesson in using the whole fish and getting more from every cut.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S05 E01 — Grilled Squid Salad and Crispy Squid on the Plancha Andrew Zimmern creates a vibrant salad where grilled squid is served with shaved fennel, cherry tomatoes, endive, and a lemon dressing. Then, Andrew shares his country-style squid on the plancha with fresh breadcrumbs, chilies, and a homemade aioli.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S04 E01 — The Essence of Grill Culture Chef Andrew Zimmern makes two different dishes with red snapper: fried snapper fingers with a spicy chile-orange mayonnaise dipping sauce and a slow-roasted whole fish with a herb salad and charred miso sweet potatoes.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S05 E09 — Southern Shrimp Skewers and Asian Crispy Rice Andrew Zimmern grills beloved shrimp in two distinct ways. He starts with jumbo shrimp and country ham skewers glazed with sweet-hot pepper jelly. Then, he creates Asian-inspired shrimp, served over crispy basmati rice and a complex sambal.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S06 E09 — Game Day Chicago-Style Beef Sandwich Andrew builds a massive Chicago-style fried beef sandwich with peppers, onions and molten cheese before tackling true snout-to-tail cooking: a whole simmered cow head transformed into crispy tacos de cabeza with two salsas.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S04 E07 — Striped Bass Crudo and Smoky Summer Succotash Chef Andrew Zimmern celebrates summer's bounty with an elegant bass crudo and a whole roasted striped bass topped with a herb-packed compound butter and served alongside a smoky corn succotash studded with charred poblanos.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S03 E08 — Nashville Hot Pheasant and Mint Basil Lemonade Chef Andrew Zimmern takes a spin on Nashville-style hot fried chicken. Hot and spicy, batter coated, crispy fried pheasant is paired with a spinach salad topped with bacon vinaigrette and ice-cold mint basil lemonade.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S03 E10 — Hawaiian Plate Lunch Andrew Zimmern reimagines the Hawaiian plate lunch with a hand chopped venison burger topped with homemade gravy and a fried egg, jumbo grilled shrimp, a humble macaroni salad and a heaping scoop of white rice.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S05 E03 — Venison Paillard and Hearty Hunter's Stew Andrew Zimmern showcases venison two ways: a delicate grilled paillard with artichokes and Parmesan, and a rich, slow-braised Polish hunter's stew with kielbasa, mushrooms, and sauerkraut. Served with grilled leeks and coal-roasted potatoes.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S03 E01 — Grilled Turkey Legs, Creamed Greens and Lemon Orzo Chef Andrew Zimmern prepares Grilled Turkey Legs, Creamed Greens and Lemon Orzo.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S05 E02 — Poultry Perfection: Moroccan Spiced Guinea Hen with Charred Vegetables Andrew unlocks the rich flavor of guinea hen with a vibrant grilled salad featuring watercress and a mustard-hazelnut vinaigrette. Then, he slow-roasts a whole bird with Middle Eastern spices, served with harissa squash and eggplant-tahini purée.

programme.desc: S04 E08 — Crispy Duck Noodle Soup Andrew Zimmern transforms wild duck into a simple grilled appetizer inspired by Japanese tataki and then uses the rest of the duck to make open fire duck noodle soup with fresh egg noodles, lots of aromatic herbs, bean sprouts and a squeeze of lime.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S04 E04 — Grilled Rabbit with Panzanella Salad Andrew Zimmern breaks down a whole rabbit to grill with a spicy, Sichuan sauce and plate with panzanella.

programme.desc: S03 E05 — Creamy Clam Chowder and Mussels in Spicy Tomato Sauce Chef Andrew Zimmern demystifies cooking clams, mussels and oysters.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S01 E06 — Vegetables, but Delicious Chef Dale crafts a family style platter of trumpet mushrooms, eggplant marinated in spicy ssam jang, and charred yellow squash served with a green goddess dressing.
programme.title: All Up In My Grill

programme.desc: S04 E02 — Yakitori and More-Y Don't sleep on grilled chicken, especially if it's Chef Dale night to cook! He's serving up Japanese style yakitori three ways, from spicy to sweet to zesty, with crispy rice, and of course he adds his own flair to these delicious skewered snacks.
programme.title: All Up In My Grill

programme.desc: S04 E07 — Street Eats off the Grill Japan, Thailand, Turkey, and Mexico street foods inspire Dale to grill with dynamically preparing Chili-Cuman Lamb Mushroom sticks, Grilled pork and shrimp shumai, and scallion pancakes with brown butter labneh.
programme.title: All Up In My Grill

programme.desc: S05 E01 — Ribs Remix Ribs are a lifestyle, and Chef Dale's living it up with smoky beef shorties in tangy red wine glaze, Miami-style pork ribs dripping in bacon-guava BBQ, spicy baked beans, and killer key lime caramel cones. Grab some napkins!
programme.title: All Up In My Grill

programme.desc: S03 E15 — Pizzapalooza Chef Dale Talde grills a Chicago-style pie, pepperoni pizza pocket, chicken wings, and a zesty grilled Caesar.
programme.title: All Up In My Grill

programme.desc: S05 E07 — Pizza-Town Dale reinvents pizza night: grilled pizza bagels loaded with pepperoni, mozzarella-stuffed penne vodka pie, a massive grilled chop salad, and olive oil cake with burnt orange caramel. Pizza goals achieved.
programme.title: All Up In My Grill

programme.desc: S03 E04 — Luxe Lobster & Prime Rib Chef Dale Talde pulls out all the stops for this daddy-sized dinner. He grills up prime rib with herb & horseradish crust, lobster & chili sauce American, charred green beans with garlic tahini, and cheddar-stuffed parker house rolls.
programme.title: All Up In My Grill

programme.desc: S04 E01 — The Art of Open Fire Cooking Chef Dale goes back to the roots of cooking, building a grill over an open fire to serve up a variety of dishes, including whole smoked chicken and fish, roasted cauliflower, a sweet and tangy grilled pineapple s'more dessert.
programme.title: All Up In My Grill

programme.desc: S03 E14 — Family-Friendly BBQ Chef Dale Talde creates a tasty menu that kids & parents alike will love! Apple pancakes with coconut brown butter syrup, grilled cheese & tomato soup, cheesy chicken parm, and a sticky s'mores dessert round out the full day of deliciousness.
programme.title: All Up In My Grill

programme.desc: S01 E02 — It's Taco Time Tacos are the way to Chef Dale's heart, and he's grilling up a sweet and smoky lemongrass and guajillo pork with pineapple, served with coconut and cotija cheese corn and an avocado jicama salad.
programme.title: All Up In My Grill

programme.desc: S05 E05 — Kabob-alicious Dale skewers ribeye, salmon, smoky eggplant dip, and grilled peaches. Food on sticks never tasted better!
programme.title: All Up In My Grill

programme.desc: S03 E09 — Scrumptious Summer Sandwiches Chef Dale Talde channels his inner sandwich lover by making an angry lobster club with pepper aioli and grilled bacon, a lamb birria torta with avocado and ramen consommé, and an Italian beef combo with chili crisp cheese sauce, giardiniera.
programme.title: All Up In My Grill

programme.desc: S05 E03 — The Heat Is On Dale's turning up the heat! Carolina Reaper wings hotter than your ex, sweet-chili NY strip steak, smoky grilled chipotle Texas toast, and ancho-gochujang pineapple skillet cake for dessert. Bring some water!
programme.title: All Up In My Grill

programme.desc: S03 E08 — Grilled Chicken 3 Ways Chef Dale Talde amps up your chicken dishes by making smoky chicken wings, a whole roasted turmeric ginger chicken with tamarind sauce, and chicken patties grilled in banana leaves with chili lime noodles. A frosty lime rickey finishes it all off!
programme.title: All Up In My Grill

programme.desc: S01 E03 — Restaurant-Style Whole Roast Fish Chef Dale grills to impress with restaurant quality meal of whole roasted fish, coconut milk grits, and snow pea, watermelon and tamarind salad.
programme.title: All Up In My Grill

programme.desc: S02 E08 — Sunday Vietnamese Brisket with Noodles Chef Dale Talde shows us how he does Sunday up right as he grills up some Vietnamese Brisket with Rice Noodles, Crispy Swordfish Summer Rolls, and tops it all off with some tasty Soju Floats. Hey, it's Sunday somewhere, right?
programme.title: All Up In My Grill

programme.desc: S03 E01 — Beer Brats & BBQ Ribs Chef Dale Talde grills up summer favorites perfect for any backyard BBQ. Cheddar beer brats in a pretzel bun, BBQ lamb ribs with Chinese mustard sauce, watermelon lime soju punch, & warm donuts with grilled strawberries & whipped cream for dessert.
programme.title: All Up In My Grill

programme.desc: S01 E05 — Brunch on the Grill Chef Dale greets the day with a Dutch baby pancake and tangerine syrup, crispy hash browns topped with crème fraîche and roe, and a ham steak smothered in sweet cherry mostarda and red eye gravy.
programme.title: All Up In My Grill

programme.desc: S04 E04 — Caribbean Latin BBQ Comforting and familiar but full of island flavor, right from the grill! Chef Dale roasts pork shoulder with chicharrones, steamy coconut rice and pigeon peas finished with frozen coconut rum drink with a charred banana.
programme.title: All Up In My Grill

programme.desc: S03 E02 — Bougie Badass Burgers Chef Dale Talde brings your basic burgers to a new level with his dry-aged beef burger with potatoes and truffle Dijon mayo, a part-beef part-pork belly burger with cheddar & an egg, and lastly a crispy mushroom tortilla burger with salsa & cheese.
programme.title: All Up In My Grill

programme.desc: S03 E09 — Scrumptious Summer Sandwiches Chef Dale Talde channels his inner sandwich lover by making an angry lobster club with pepper aioli and grilled bacon, a lamb birria torta with avocado and ramen consommé, and an Italian beef combo with chili crisp cheese sauce, giardiniera.
programme.title: All Up In My Grill

programme.desc: S05 E02 — Bussin' Burgers Chef Dale is flipping burgers into art - gooey mac & cheeseburgers, fancy French patties topped with melty bucheron cheese, crispy parm-truffle fries, and peanut butter fudge ice cream sandwiches. Get hungry.
programme.title: All Up In My Grill

programme.desc: S05 E04 — Tandoor On The Grill Dale fires up the tandoor grill, turning out juicy chicken thighs, smoky shrimp with Old Bay yogurt, crispy cauliflower, and a silky mango lassi dessert topped with crunchy candied pistachios. Tandoori done right!
programme.title: All Up In My Grill

programme.desc: S03 E03 — Feast of Killer Crab & Perfect Pork Belly Chef Dale Talde prepares a finger food feast with char grilled chili crab, spiced adobo potatoes, grilled pork belly, & sofrito stuffed branzino all served on a bed of rice over banana leaves. Call your friends - this is a feast that will feed many!
programme.title: All Up In My Grill

programme.desc: S01 E04 — These Smoked Turkey Legs are better than the State Fair Kevin and Noah smoke up some State Fair Turkey Legs; fry some skillet Chorizo & Eggs; smoke-and-fry some Buffalo Rib Tips; and cook up some Sriracha and Garlic-Butter Grilled Shrimp.
programme.title: Barbecue: Smoke Out

programme.title: Barbecue: Smoke Out

programme.desc: S02 E02 — Southern Comfort: Oxtails, Collard Greens and Dirty Rice We're cooking Smoked Oxtails; BBQ Oxtail Spaghetti; Cowboy Skillet Breakfast; Dirty Rice and Collard Greens.

programme.desc: S05 E07 — Grilled Clams Casino and Garlicky Clam Pizza Andrew Zimmern celebrates cherrystone clams with two show-stopping recipes. He prepares classic grilled clams casino with pancetta, then pushes boundaries with an innovative grilled pizza topped with clams, garlic, chiles, and cheese.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S06 E08 — Tailgate Surf-and-Turf Po'Boy Sandwiches Seafood takes center stage as Andrew fries shrimp, squid and small whole fish for Sicilian-style fritto misto, then layers crispy walleye and oysters into a fully dressed po'boy with savory beef gravy.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S03 E08 — Nashville Hot Pheasant and Mint Basil Lemonade Chef Andrew Zimmern takes a spin on Nashville-style hot fried chicken. Hot and spicy, batter coated, crispy fried pheasant is paired with a spinach salad topped with bacon vinaigrette and ice-cold mint basil lemonade.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S06 E09 — Game Day Chicago-Style Beef Sandwich Andrew builds a massive Chicago-style fried beef sandwich with peppers, onions and molten cheese before tackling true snout-to-tail cooking: a whole simmered cow head transformed into crispy tacos de cabeza with two salsas.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S04 E04 — Grilled Rabbit with Panzanella Salad Andrew Zimmern breaks down a whole rabbit to grill with a spicy, Sichuan sauce and plate with panzanella.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S04 E02 — Back to Our Caveman Roots Chef Andrew Zimmern goes primal with two antelope dishes: a Greek-style whole leg roasted over the open fire with a lemony avgolemono sauce and crispy potatoes, and a simple antelope tenderloin carpaccio served with roasted tomatoes and Parmesan.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S03 E05 — Creamy Clam Chowder and Mussels in Spicy Tomato Sauce Chef Andrew Zimmern demystifies cooking clams, mussels and oysters.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S04 E06 — Grilled Eggplant Caponata Toast and Crispy Squab Katsu Andrew Zimmern creates an elegant, seared pigeon toast crowned with a Sicilian caponata bursting with grilled eggplant, olives, and capers and a crispy pigeon katsu served with a refreshing shaved cabbage salad and punchy ginger-carrot vinaigrette.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S05 E02 — Poultry Perfection: Moroccan Spiced Guinea Hen with Charred Vegetables Andrew unlocks the rich flavor of guinea hen with a vibrant grilled salad featuring watercress and a mustard-hazelnut vinaigrette. Then, he slow-roasts a whole bird with Middle Eastern spices, served with harissa squash and eggplant-tahini purée.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S05 E10 — Wild Boar Feast: Chorizo with Mussels and Whole Roasted Leg Wild boar takes center stage! Andrew makes chorizo with mussels, preserved lemon & white wine. Then, he slow-roasts a whole leg over fire, served Southern-style with pickled cherries, glazed onions & mustard sauce.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S05 E06 — Minnesota's Foraged Mushroom Feast Andrew Zimmern explores Minnesota's forests for wild mushrooms. He creates a simple grilled mushroom salad, then hand-shapes cavatelli pasta tossed with golden chanterelles, butter, garlic, thyme, and colatura. He shares foraging and cleaning tips.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S06 E07 — The Wild Boar Playbook Andrew turns wild boar into the ultimate game-day spread with boar and black bean chili topped with crisp cornbread waffles, and pulled boar sliders braised low and slow in Carolina Gold mustard sauce.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S03 E04 — Bison Tomahawk Chop with Italian-style Eggplant and Panzanella Chef Andrew Zimmern shares a simple trick for getting the most out of bison tomahawk chops.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S06 E03 — The Most Underrated Game Bird Goose, one of Andrew's favorite game birds, is prepared two ways: a French onion soup-style grilled breast sandwich with caramelized onions and melted cheese, and a whole bird, cured, roasted on a beer can, and served with an apple-fennel salad.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S04 E08 — Crispy Duck Noodle Soup Andrew Zimmern transforms wild duck into a simple grilled appetizer inspired by Japanese tataki and then uses the rest of the duck to make open fire duck noodle soup with fresh egg noodles, lots of aromatic herbs, bean sprouts and a squeeze of lime.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S05 E04 — Mediterranean Grilled Filets and Salt Crusted Halibut Andrew Zimmern elevates California halibut, first with grilled fillets on saffron labneh with romesco and roasted cabbage. Then, he demonstrates a classic salt-crusted whole halibut, served with whole roasted cauliflower and a rich cream sauce.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S06 E10 — The Ultimate Elk Tailgate It's an elk tailgate over live fire. Andrew makes chorizo-spiced elk meatballs with queso fundido and red chile salsa, then cooks hay-smoked elk chops with charred alliums and black garlic-juniper butter.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S04 E09 — Wild Seafood Risotto Chef Andrew Zimmern demystifies working with live sea urchin and scallops by creating a showstopping seafood risotto.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S03 E09 — Tuna 101: Grilled, Poached and Raw Chef Andrew Zimmern breaks down a whole tuna and serves it three ways: grilled, raw, and poached.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S03 E07 — Goat Curry with Rice Pilaf and Carmelized Onions Chef Andrew butchers a whole goat, using the leg and backstrap for a braised curry.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S06 E05 — Bison Brats & Grilled Kebabs on Flatbread Andrew butchers a whole bison leg before diving in to grinding meat for bison brats, grilling them up and topping with homemade spicy mustard. Then, he grills Middle Eastern-inspired kebabs to serve over flatbread for a feast built for sharing.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S04 E05 — Yakitori-Style Skewers and Pheasant Flatbread Andrew butchers a whole pheasant to make yakitori-style skewers and a homemade flatbread, cucumber salad and a mango chutney.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S03 E10 — Hawaiian Plate Lunch Andrew Zimmern reimagines the Hawaiian plate lunch with a hand chopped venison burger topped with homemade gravy and a fried egg, jumbo grilled shrimp, a humble macaroni salad and a heaping scoop of white rice.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S03 E06 — Braised Pigeon with Homemade Herb Gnocchi Chef Andrew Zimmern cooks braised squab with olives and vinegar, a perfect meal for a fall evening.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S03 E02 — Carne Adovada Chef Andrew Zimmern prepares Carne Adovada.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S03 E01 — Grilled Turkey Legs, Creamed Greens and Lemon Orzo Chef Andrew Zimmern prepares Grilled Turkey Legs, Creamed Greens and Lemon Orzo.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S04 E10 — Holy Mackerel! Andrew Zimmern champions the often-overlooked mackerel with a main salad of pickled filets, charred tomatoes, grilled frisée, and sweet summer peaches. Then, he grills it whole seasoned with caramelized onions, rutabaga mash and charred grapes.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S05 E08 — Elk Tenderloin Tostadas and Grilled Rack of Ribs Andrew Zimmern highlights lean elk, first crafting classic Mexican tostadas with grilled tenderloin, avocado, and homemade salsa macha. Then, he grills a whole rack of elk, serving it with creamy colcannon, tarragon emulsion, and rosemary charcoal.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S03 E03 — A Whole Roasted Hog For pig roast perfection, Chef Andrew Zimmern marinates a whole hog.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S04 E03 — Tailgate Tacos and Bison Bolognese Chef Andrew Zimmern starts simmering a classic Italian Bolognese sauce, with ground bison, lots of red wine and tomatoes. Then, he adds marinated bison skirt steak tacos with borracho beans to the tailgate menu.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S06 E02 — Grilled Yellowtail Collars & Filets with Miso Sauce Andrew cooks yellowtail two ways: grilled collars with a sweet, savory Filipino-inspired adobo sauce, and grilled filets with miso sauce, shiso butter, and charred vegetables. A lesson in using the whole fish and getting more from every cut.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S05 E05 — The King of Open-Fire Paella Andrew Zimmern showcases quail two ways: classic Southern fried quail with lemon-basil aioli, and as an elevated topping for a traditional open-fire paella, complete with crispy socarrat. He proves this small bird makes an extraordinary dinner.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S05 E09 — Southern Shrimp Skewers and Asian Crispy Rice Andrew Zimmern grills beloved shrimp in two distinct ways. He starts with jumbo shrimp and country ham skewers glazed with sweet-hot pepper jelly. Then, he creates Asian-inspired shrimp, served over crispy basmati rice and a complex sambal.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S04 E01 — The Essence of Grill Culture Chef Andrew Zimmern makes two different dishes with red snapper: fried snapper fingers with a spicy chile-orange mayonnaise dipping sauce and a slow-roasted whole fish with a herb salad and charred miso sweet potatoes.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S04 E07 — Striped Bass Crudo and Smoky Summer Succotash Chef Andrew Zimmern celebrates summer's bounty with an elegant bass crudo and a whole roasted striped bass topped with a herb-packed compound butter and served alongside a smoky corn succotash studded with charred poblanos.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S09 E08 — Super Sonoran Pati makes three classic Sonoran recipes: a fish special called pescado zarandeado, a rich stew called gallina pinta and a tasty dirty rice with clams. In Sonora, she visits vacation destination Puerto Peñasco.
programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table

programme.desc: S09 E07 — Legends of the Sonoran Sea Pati travels to Sonora's coast on the Sea of Cortez, where local legend Toño Contreras gives her a tour including shellfish on the beach, his restaurant Mariscos El Rey, and his home kitchen for some crave-worthy recipes.
programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table

programme.desc: S10 E02 — Food Meets Art Pati explores some unique spots in Guadalajara where food and art truly connect. In her kitchen, she makes pollo a la valentina, rice with poblanos and corn, and an almond tres leches cake.
programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table

programme.desc: S09 E09 — Cooking for the Crew Pati prepares a true Sonoran feast for the crew - Sonora cheese soup, chicken in pecan and ancho chile sauce.
programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table

programme.desc: S10 E05 — Jalisco Style Birria Pati experiences the Escaramuza — An all-female horse riding and skills competition. In the kitchen, Pati makes Jalisco-style birria and her friend, pastry chef and cookbook author Fany Gerson, joins her to make gelatinas for dessert.
programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table

programme.desc: S10 E07 — Getting to the Roots Pati meets the young chefs behind one of Guadalajara's most exciting restaurants, Xokol. Back home, Pati invites her friend Francisco Migoya over to make conchas to go with pellizcadas with chicharrón in salsa verde.
programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table

programme.desc: S10 E04 — Los Mariachis Pati learns about the history, the instruments, and the meaning behind Mariachi music. Pati makes carne en su jugo, tres chiles guacamole, and masa berry shortcake.
programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table

programme.desc: S10 E01 — Welcome to Guadalajara Pati explores the culinary highlights of Jalisco's capital city, Guadalajara. She starts at a street cart to taste the city's most iconic sandwich, tortas ahogadas. Then, she meets one of the city's best chefs, Fabian Delgado.
programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table

programme.desc: S09 E06 — Sonoran Family Favorites Pati spends a day in the kitchen with her middle son, Sami, cooking recipes inspired by her travels in Sonora that she knows he'll love - beef and potato chimichangas, rice with lentils and caramelized onions, and an avocado and radish salad.
programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table

programme.desc: S10 E06 — Tradition and Innovation Pati meets chef and historian Maru Toledo who is working to preserve and pass on some of Jalisco's most important regional recipes. Pati makes Jalisco-style chicken tamales and chile relleno rice dressed with salsa roja.
programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table

programme.desc: S09 E10 — Hacienda Ranch Food Pati makes traditional tamales with corn, chiles, and cheese, and then for the main course, pork chops topped with a pickled grape salad. In Sonora, she visits a traditional hacienda, where she gets a true taste of Sonoran ranch food.
programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table

programme.desc: S10 E10 — Tacos and a Tostada Pati celebrates everyone's favorite Mexican creation, the taco. In her kitchen, Pati creates a pair of Jalisco-inspired tacos and a Ceviche tostada that are sure to satisfy any true taco-lover.
programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table

programme.desc: S11 E07 — Cantina Culture and the Morning After? Cantinas have historically been bars where men gather to drink and sing about their broken hearts. Historian David Canales takes Pati to historic locations. Then she tries the best tacos in town.
programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table

programme.desc: S12 E01 — The Nectar of the Mayan Gods Pati is in the magic town of Maní to learn about something sacred to the Mayans - bees and honey. A group of women who protect the endangered Melipona, a stingless bee native to Yucatán, invites her to join in a Mayan energy cleansing ritual.
programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table

programme.desc: S11 E09 — A Day With Hugo Chef Hugo Guajardo researches the best of Nuevo León's ingredients. He and Pati visit a family-owned restaurant that has perfected the art of drying meat. Then, she tries his famed charred chicken.
programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table

programme.desc: S11 E08 — Texas BBQ in the Orange Belt Pati visits BBQ champion Luis Rivas to taste his Mexican take on Texas-style BBQ, and he hosts a traditional carne asada at his family's orange grove. Then Pati learns how Glorias candies are made.
programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table

programme.desc: S11 E05 — The Magic of Piloncillo The Garza family invites Pati to their vineyard to help the community make piloncillo - and it's hard work! Then, in the magic town of Bustamante, three sisters make traditional bread in adobe ovens.
programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table

programme.desc: S11 E06 — Pioneering From Farm to Table Gaby Molinar owns Huerto Urbano, an urban farm dedicated to providing Monterrey with nutritious, diverse local ingredients. And her husband is one of the region's greatest culinary pioneers.
programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table

programme.desc: S11 E02 — Sisters, Stew, and Sass Two sisters made a little shack on the Rio Ramos into a must-visit restaurant known for one dish: cortadillo stew. Down the road, another restaurant uses traditional stews in their famous empalmes.
programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table

programme.desc: S11 E03 — The World Cup of Tacos Nuevo León is divided between two pro soccer teams: Los Tigres and Los Rayados. Pati tries the food at each stadium with the teams' stars to determine who wins in the battle of tortas vs tacos.
programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table

programme.desc: S11 E01 — The Fire Kings Gualberto "Weber" Elizondo surprised his family when his grilling hobby turned him into a local celebrity and internet sensation. Meanwhile, chef Chuy Villareal of Cara De Vaca wants the world to know that the north of Mexico isn't just carne asada.
programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table

programme.desc: S01 E04 — Not Your Nonna's Gnocchi and Meatballs In this episode Jamie takes midweek meals up a notch, knocking out a flavour-packed, simple gnocchi supper and giant spicy meatballs full of delicious time-saving cheats, and turns a family favourite on its head with his upside-down fish pie.

programme.desc: S01 E03 — Crispy Rolled Pork Belly and Risotto Jamie shares more fabulous one-pan dishes: foolproof tray-baked salmon in a bag; super-easy tomato fritters that you can rattle out in a frying pan; and roasted rolled pork and a risotto that are BOTH cooked in the same casserole pan. Result!

programme.desc: S01 E04 — The Chicken Episode Chef Dale kicks up the heat with his angry chicken, a spicy, spatchcocked and grilled whole chicken, and his kung pao chicken wings.
programme.title: All Up In My Grill

programme.desc: S03 E07 — Top of the Line Steaks Chef Dale Talde is back to level up his steak game by grilling up a NY strip steak with roasted onions & poblanos, short ribs with chili paste and horseradish, and a grilled châteaubriand with charred Broccolini. Steak your claim on these dishes!
programme.title: All Up In My Grill

programme.desc: S02 E01 — Apocalypse Burgers Chef Dale Talde kicks the summer off right with a burger blowout featuring Brisket Burgers with Grilled Onions and Blue Cheese, Shrimp Burgers with XO Sauce and a Fried Egg, and Lamb Sliders with Feta Ranch and don't forget the Lemon Oregano Fries.
programme.title: All Up In My Grill

programme.desc: S02 E03 — Summer Surf 'n' Turf Chef Dale Talde kicks lobster & steak to the curb as he puts a Spanish-style spin on your typical surf 'n' turf by creating Pork & Clams, Lobster and Mushroom Fideos, and Tomato & Tuna Bread, then washing it all down with a tasty Michelada.
programme.title: All Up In My Grill

programme.desc: S03 E08 — Grilled Chicken 3 Ways Chef Dale Talde amps up your chicken dishes by making smoky chicken wings, a whole roasted turmeric ginger chicken with tamarind sauce, and chicken patties grilled in banana leaves with chili lime noodles. A frosty lime rickey finishes it all off!
programme.title: All Up In My Grill

programme.desc: S03 E09 — Scrumptious Summer Sandwiches Chef Dale Talde channels his inner sandwich lover by making an angry lobster club with pepper aioli and grilled bacon, a lamb birria torta with avocado and ramen consommé, and an Italian beef combo with chili crisp cheese sauce, giardiniera.
programme.title: All Up In My Grill

programme.desc: S02 E06 — Grill These Sandwiches Mad Good Food Host Derrell Smith joins Chef Dale Talde at the grill as they cook up some stupendous sandwiches including a Salmon Pastrami Reuben, a Meatball Banh Mi, and even some Grilled Ice Cream Sandwiches.
programme.title: All Up In My Grill

programme.desc: S03 E05 — Summer Seafood Smorgasbord Chef Dale Talde gets his beach vibes going with a grilled shrimp & lobster cocktail, clams with lemon breadcrumbs, a killer grilled king crab with burnt citrus butter, and a chilled mango frozen daiquiri. Don't you dare miss this beach party!
programme.title: All Up In My Grill

programme.desc: S02 E07 — New Orleans-Style Shrimp & Oysters Chef Dale Talde brings us to the bayou as he creates a NOLA-inspired menu complete with Chargrilled Oysters, Black Pepper Shrimp Po'boys, finishes it off with Bananas Foster, and washes it all down with a Fruity Grilled Hurricane.
programme.title: All Up In My Grill

programme.desc: S01 E08 — End of Summer Seafood Feast The end of summer is near, and Chef Dale makes a giant seafood feast; lobster, crab, clams, shrimp, and scallops, all served directly on the table with plenty of buttery garlic bread.
programme.title: All Up In My Grill

programme.desc: S02 E04 — Perfectly Prepared Steaks Big Daddy Dale Talde shows you how to marinate, prep, & grill up the biggest and best steaks out there. From a Hanger Steak with Salsa Verde to a Ribeye with Ginger Chili Relish, and tops it all off with the father of all steaks… The Porterhouse.
programme.title: All Up In My Grill

programme.desc: S02 E02 — Sausage Egg & Cheese All Day Long Chef Dale Talde brings out the best of brunch with sweet and savory hits such as Bacon Wrapped Dates Stuffed with Chorizo, Maple Sausage, Egg, & Cheese Fried Rice, and the tastiest BBQ Duck, Egg, & Corn Scallion Pancake Sandwiches you've ever eaten.
programme.title: All Up In My Grill

programme.desc: S01 E05 — Brunch on the Grill Chef Dale greets the day with a Dutch baby pancake and tangerine syrup, crispy hash browns topped with crème fraîche and roe, and a ham steak smothered in sweet cherry mostarda and red eye gravy.
programme.title: All Up In My Grill

programme.desc: S02 E05 — Pizza Party on the Grill It's Pizza Time! Chef Dale Talde grills up amazing pizzas for every palate including a Detroit Style Pie, a Cheddar Naan Pie with a Spiced Chick Peas & Potatoes, and gives your childhood favorite French Bread Pizza a much-needed upgrade.
programme.title: All Up In My Grill

programme.desc: S01 E07 — Kabobs and Skewers Kabobs and skewers are a family tradition for Chef Dale; a Mediterranean-inspired meal features beef and shrimp kabobs with grilled tomatoes, potatoes, and eggplant, all served on warm pita with a tangy white sauce.
programme.title: All Up In My Grill

programme.desc: S02 E02 — Southern Comfort: Oxtails, Collard Greens and Dirty Rice We're cooking Smoked Oxtails; BBQ Oxtail Spaghetti; Cowboy Skillet Breakfast; Dirty Rice and Collard Greens.
programme.title: Barbecue: Smoke Out

programme.title: Barbecue: Smoke Out

programme.desc: S06 E01 — The Best Fish You're Not Eating Andrew takes on "little fish, big fish," cooking grilled whole small fish over Japanese charcoal with sesame spinach, and a larger fish in a bold puttanesca-style dish. Simple techniques, big flavor, and a case for eating lower on the food chain.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S06 E04 — How to Cook a Whole Pig at Home Andrew tackles suckling pig with two recipes-his take on a three-cup braise with soy, rice wine, and sesame oil, served with plancha fried rice, and a whole pig roasted over open fire and pulled for Philly-style pork sandwiches with broccoli rabe.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S06 E06 — Game Day Fried Squab Andrew gives squab the game-day treatment with two bold recipes: crispy Buffalo-style fried squab with blue cheese and ranch, and red chile grilled squab taquitos with green tomatillo salsa, cotija and crema.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S03 E01 — Grilled Turkey Legs, Creamed Greens and Lemon Orzo Chef Andrew Zimmern prepares Grilled Turkey Legs, Creamed Greens and Lemon Orzo.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S03 E02 — Carne Adovada Chef Andrew Zimmern prepares Carne Adovada.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S03 E03 — A Whole Roasted Hog For pig roast perfection, Chef Andrew Zimmern marinates a whole hog.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S03 E04 — Bison Tomahawk Chop with Italian-style Eggplant and Panzanella Chef Andrew Zimmern shares a simple trick for getting the most out of bison tomahawk chops.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S03 E05 — Creamy Clam Chowder and Mussels in Spicy Tomato Sauce Chef Andrew Zimmern demystifies cooking clams, mussels and oysters.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S03 E06 — Braised Pigeon with Homemade Herb Gnocchi Chef Andrew Zimmern cooks braised squab with olives and vinegar, a perfect meal for a fall evening.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S03 E07 — Goat Curry with Rice Pilaf and Carmelized Onions Chef Andrew butchers a whole goat, using the leg and backstrap for a braised curry.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S03 E08 — Nashville Hot Pheasant and Mint Basil Lemonade Chef Andrew Zimmern takes a spin on Nashville-style hot fried chicken. Hot and spicy, batter coated, crispy fried pheasant is paired with a spinach salad topped with bacon vinaigrette and ice-cold mint basil lemonade.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S03 E09 — Tuna 101: Grilled, Poached and Raw Chef Andrew Zimmern breaks down a whole tuna and serves it three ways: grilled, raw, and poached.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.title: Close Calls: On Camera

programme.title: Close Calls: On Camera

programme.desc: Presenting the latest products live on television that can be ordered directly. The product range extends from vacuum cleaners and bath towels to sports equipment.
programme.title: Teleshopping

programme.desc: S22 E9 — Quick! Take This Homeless Baby?!; Single Mother Mayhem! All hell breaks loose when a woman asks her mother to take care of her homeless friend's child. Young, single mothers move out of their family homes and decide to live together only to fight over who gets the master bedroom.
programme.title: Judge Judy

programme.desc: S22 E10 — Harlequin Great Dane Rescue?!; Whatever You Do ... Don't Answer the Phone! A woman demands that her Great Dane be returned after a long absence and an unnecessary medical procedure. A woman makes a $5,000 mistake when she answers a random call from a telemarketer.
programme.title: Judge Judy

programme.desc: S22 E11 — Heartthrob Concert Chaos! A 9-year-old's birthday party takes an unfortunate turn, ending in accusations of assault, bullying and feuding mothers.
programme.title: Judge Judy

programme.desc: S22 E12 — Drugs, Kids and Feuding Parents; Childcare Drama; Drug Arrests and Friendship Tests A father gets sued for claiming his children, who were taken by CPS, as dependents. A single mother gets a job but becomes accused of failing to pay for her children's daycare. After an arrest, a woman's friend bails her out but then demands payback.
programme.title: Judge Judy

programme.desc: S17 E94 — Love, Lies and Deceit; Impounding My Heart A former fiance sues for the return of property and punitive damages for filing a restraining order he says is false. A man regrets lending a friend money to get her car out of impound.
programme.title: Judge Judy

programme.desc: S17 E92 — Surprise, You're a Daddy!; Cat Fight! An unwed father's ex-boss sues him for repayment of a loan to pay back child support. Women get into a physical altercation over the sale of a car.
programme.title: Judge Judy

programme.desc: S17 E91 — Boxer Boo Boo; Ex-Lover Association Fight A dog sprains its foot. A man wants his ex to repay a debt.
programme.title: Judge Judy

programme.desc: S17 E72 — Mother/Daughter No Love Lost A woman accuses her daughter of vandalising her home, stealing her things and filing a false restraining order.
programme.title: Judge Judy

programme.desc: S21 E73 — Jealousy-Fueled Vandalism?!; Fire Pit Craziness?! Bitten Buyer?! A man's girlfriend accuses him of repeatedly kicking her car; a landlady discovers a fire pit on her property; an Australian terrier accused of biting a man.
programme.title: Judge Judy

programme.desc: S21 E74 — Most Wanted Shoplifter?!; The Reluctant Landlord? A store's customer becomes shocked to see a photo of himself portrayed as a shoplifter; a landlady sues a tenant for harassment.
programme.title: Judge Judy

programme.desc: S21 E75 — Faulty Family Business?! A woman sues contractors for shoddy workmanship; they say she held their tools hostage and extorted money from them.
programme.title: Judge Judy

programme.desc: S22 E34 — Dogsitting Disaster!; Surprise! We're Squatters?! A woman claims her friend lost one of her dogs and that another pet died on her couch while she was away on holiday. A woman and her roommate are surprised to find that their flat is not owned by their landlord when police escort them out.
programme.title: Judge Judy

programme.desc: S22 E35 — Child Abuse Allegations and Assault? Custody exchange drama escalates when a woman confronts her estranged husband about scratches on their child.
programme.title: Judge Judy

programme.desc: S22 E36 — Spiteful Grandpa?; Timber! Healthy Tree Takedown! A woman accuses her fiancé's father of suing her out of spite because he doesn't get to see his granddaughter as much as he'd like to. The judge reminds a property owner that he's lucky that his amateur handyman efforts didn't kill someone.
programme.title: Judge Judy

programme.desc: W poprzedniej kolejce Rennes rozbiło 3:0 Strasbourg. Autorem dwóch trafień w tym spotkaniu był Sebastian Szymański. Szanse na kolejne Polak może mieć w rywalizacji z Niceą. Zespół z Lazurowego Wybrzeża do fatalnym początku sezonu wstał z kolan i pnie się w górę tabeli. Obecnie na swoim koncie ma już 11 punktów i próbuje włączyć się do walki o europejskie puchary.
programme.title: Liga francuska - mecz: OGC Nice - Stade Rennais FC

programme.desc: Opowieść o AJ Auxerre. Klub został założony w 1905 roku w niewielkim mieście w Burgundii. Mimo lokalizacji z dala od metropolii przez lata rzucał wyzwanie tuzom francuskiego futbolu. Największy sukces odniósł w 1996 roku, gdy został mistrzem Ligue 1.

programme.title: Liga włoska - mecz: Juventus FC - SSC Napoli

programme.desc: Stuttgart jest cieniem drużyny, która ukończyła poprzedni sezon Bundesligi na czwartym miejscu w tabeli. Die Roten balansują tuż nad strefą spadkową, mając na koncie aż pięć porażek w siedmiu kolejkach. Biorąc pod uwagę okoliczności, ich zwycięstwo nad Bayerem Leverkusen wydaje się mało prawdopodobnym scenariuszem.

programme.desc: Po imponującym początku Monaco złapało zadyszkę i nie zdołało wygrać 3 ostatnich ligowych spotkań. Spadek formy rywala chce wykorzystać Paris FC. Zespół ze stolicy mimo porażki z RC Lens (1:2) cały czas może znaleźć się na ligowym podium. Musi jednak pokonać u siebie drużynę z Księstwa Monako.
programme.title: Liga francuska - mecz: Paris FC - AS Monaco

programme.desc: Mecze Bayernu z Borussią Dortmund od lat nadają ton rywalizacji o mistrzostwo Niemiec. Nie inaczej będzie z Der Klassikerem numer 141, który zostanie rozegrany w ramach ósmej kolejki kampanii 2026/27. Bawarczycy i piłkarze BVB do połowy października szli łeb w łeb w wyścigu o tytuł. Ich bezpośrednie starcie na Allianz Arenie najprawdopodobniej zadecyduje o tym, który z gigantów zostanie samodzielnym liderem Bundesligi. Podopieczni Vincenta Kompany'ego mają nad Dortmundczykami przewagę psychologiczną. Znajdują się bowiem na fali trzech zwycięstw z rzędu nad Borussią. Ostatnim razem pokonali ją 2:1 w sierpniowym meczu o Superpuchar Niemiec.
programme.title: Liga niemiecka - mecz: FC Bayern Monachium - Borussia Dortmund

programme.desc: Udinese w poprzedniej kolejce ponownie nie zdołało odnieść zwycięstwa, remisując bezbramkowo z Parmą. Było to już jego siódme ligowe spotkanie z rzędu bez wygranej. Domowe starcie z AS Romą zapowiada się więc dla gospodarzy jako bardzo duże wyzwanie, zwłaszcza że ekipa z Rzymu do tej pory nie przegrała i przed 10. serią spotkań zajmuje trzecie miejsce w tabeli. Goście w ostatniej kolejce pokonali Cagliari 4:2.
programme.title: Liga włoska - mecz: Udinese Calcio - AS Roma

programme.desc: Po gorszym początku sezonu Paryżanie wrócili do poziomu, którym zachwycali kibiców na całym świecie. W poprzedniej serii spotkań wygrali z Le Havre AC aż 5:1. W 10. kolejce Paris Saint-Germain podejmie ESTAC Troyes. Przyjezdni odnieśli ostatnio drugie ligowe zwycięstwo w tym sezonie, pokonując 2:0 Le Mans FC.

programme.desc: Zarówno Eintracht Frankfurt, jak i Hamburger SV zanotowały w poprzedniej kolejce porażki. Eintracht uległ 0:1 Borussii Dortmund, natomiast HSV musiał uznać wyższość Paderborn (0:1). Obie ekipy z pewnością postarają się wrócić na zwycięską ścieżkę, co zapowiada wyrównane starcie.
programme.title: Liga niemiecka - mecz: Eintracht Frankfurt - Hamburger SV

programme.desc: Strasbourg jest największym rozczarowaniem tej części sezonu. W lidze zdołał wygrać zaledwie 2 spotkania i znajduje się w strefie spadkowej. Dodatkowo na zwycięstwo czeka od 6 września. Przełamać się i tym samym opuścić ostatnie lokaty spróbuje starciem z Auxerre. Zadanie to będzie jednak bardzo trudne. Po fatalnym starcie podopieczni Willa Stilla obudzili się i w ciągu 5 kolejek zdobyli 10 punktów, tym samym zbliżając się do środka stawki.
programme.title: Liga francuska - mecz: RC Strasbourg - AJ Auxerre

programme.desc: Twórcy przypominają historyczny sezon Werderu zakończony zdobyciem podwójnej korony: mistrzostwa Bundesligi i Pucharu Niemiec. W rozgrywkach 2003/2004 trenerem zespołu z Bremy był Thomas Schaaf. Zielono-białe barwy reprezentowali wówczas m.in. Angelos Charisteas,Christian Schulz i Frank Baumann.
programme.title: Werder Double

programme.desc: Biografie najlepszych obrońców lat 90., którzy trwale zapisali się w historii niemieckiej ekstraklasy. Widzowie poznają życiorysy takich piłkarzy, jak: Mike Werner, Lothar Matthäus, Thomas Helmer, Matthias Sammer czy Jens Nowotny.

Kolejne potknięcie nie tylko po raz kolejny oddali go od mistrzostwa, ale także może zrzucić go z ligowego podium. Uniknąć tego spróbuje w rywalizacji z walczącą o utrzymanie Casa Pią.

programme.desc: Nie tak fani Troyes wyobrażali sobie powrót do Ligue 1. Po ośmiu kolejkach ich ulubieńcy znajdują się na przedostatnim miejscu w tabeli z zaledwie jednym zwycięstwem na koncie. Wydostać się ze strefy spadkowej mogą już w tej kolejce. Zmierzą się z Le Mans FC, które zajmuje ostatnią bezpieczną lokatę.

programme.desc: Starcie wielkich firm, które obecny sezon zaczęły zdecydowanie poniżej oczekiwań. Przetrzebiona kontuzjami Stara Dama spróbuje pokonać notującego kolejne wpadki wicemistrza. Szczególnie bolesna była przegrana Błękitnych z zajmującą ostatnie miejsce w tabeli Venezią.

programme.desc: Bologna Łukasza Skorupskiego w poprzedniej kolejce niespodziewanie pokonała AC Milan 4:2. Szczęście, nerwy ze stali i umiejętności techniczne są potrzebne, by dobrze wykonywać rzuty karne. Umiejętność ta jest bardzo ważna, bo strzały z jedenastu metrów rozstrzygały o losach niejednego ważnego spotkania.
programme.title: Dramatyczne rzuty karne

programme.desc: FC Porto nadal może pochwalić się kompletem zwycięstw w lidze. Ma ich już na koncie 10, a w poprzednim meczu pokonało Estoril 4:0. O przedłużenie tej imponującej serii podopieczni Francesco Farioliego powalczą w 11. kolejce na wyjeździe z Vitorią SC.

programme.desc: A Trinidad, uno de los pistoleros más rápidos del Oeste, y a su hermano mayor, un granuja peor que él apodado 'El niño', no les sale nada bien. Su último golpe, el asalto a una diligencia, resulta un fracaso total por no llevar nadie dinero encima. Sin embargo, el azar los conduce a un pueblo en el que los toman por 'rangers' y son agasajados como príncipes... a cambio de que pongan a raya a una banda de forajidos que tiene atemorizado al pueblo. La situación se complica cuando aparecen las verdaderas autoridades y los hermanos son confundidos con unos peligrosos traficantes de armas. Para despistar a las fuerzas del orden, los hermanos se esconden en un convento de frailes.
programme.title: Le seguían llamando Trinidad

programme.desc: Un misterioso desconocido viaja a un remoto pueblo donde, 15 años antes, fueron secuestradas su mujer y su hija.
programme.title: El rastreador

programme.desc: Dempsey es un vaquero solitario que entra a trabajar en el rancho Triángulo, propiedad de una ambiciosa ganadera. Esta comienza a expoliar de sus pastos a los pequeños rancheros que responden vallando sus campos con alambre de espino. Dempsey se ve enfrentado entre sus ansias de libertad que le llevan a rechazar el sistema de cercas y su sentido de la justicia, que le impulsa hacia el bando de los pequeños rancheros.
programme.title: La pradera sin ley

programme.title: A business empire

programme.desc: Hatred and the desire for revenge smoldered in the minds of many Germans after the First World War. Many Germans believe that the Jews are the cause of all kinds of problems.
programme.title: The Seeds of Violence 1918-1922

programme.desc: Hitler and his movement seem to be eliminated after his failed putsch on November 9, 1923, the movement is banned, the self-proclaimed leaders are imprisoned.
programme.title: Deceit and Delusion 1923-1928

programme.desc: In the late 1920s, Germany was seething. Social protest turns into a racist and anti-Jewish movement, Hitler and his NSDAP using their anger against the “system” for their own benefits.
programme.title: Democracy without Democrats 1929-1933

programme.desc: After the 1933 parliament fire, President Hindenburg signs a decree that suspends freedom of speech. In mock elections, Hitler secures approval; with terror, he intimi-dates his adversaries.
programme.title: The Racial State 1933-1934

programme.desc: In October 1934, Hitler's government is firmly in the saddle. The majority of Germans support Hitler's offensive anti-Jewish policy.
programme.title: Hidden in Plain Sight 1935-1938

programme.desc: At the end of 1939, the German Army has invaded Poland. They are followed closely by the SS (Schutzstaffel) task forces, which have only one mission: To murder the Polish intelligence.
programme.title: Up in Flames 1936-1940

programme.desc: Harrowing testimonials from victims show how in 1944 the SS stepped up the “efficiency” of the death factory at Auschwitz and how the perpetrators documented their “work”.
programme.title: Auschwitz One Day

programme.desc: "The Royals, the British Aristocracy and the Nazis" presents documents and footage proving the royal family’s and leading British aristocrats’ sympathy for National Socialism.
programme.title: The Royals, the British Aristocracy and the Nazis

programme.desc: The film "The Moon Landing and the Nazis" documents the involvement of German NASA employees with the Third Reich.
programme.title: The Moon Landing and the Nazis

programme.desc: The first programme features four bunkers built before World War Two. We begin with the legendary Franzensfeste in today’s northern Italy, a fortress that was never besieged.
programme.title: Concrete Against Bombs

programme.desc: The second programme features shelters in the nuclear era in Lithuania, Germany and Albania.
programme.title: Facing Nuclear Annihilation

programme.title: Dokumentar
programme.desc: Oplev et følelsesladet og nostalgisk tilbageblik på mesterskabet, ingen troede muligt. Hør historierne bag sæsonen, der kulminerede i Brøndby IF’s første triumf i 16 år – fortalt af dem, der selv var med til at skrive historien.

programme.title: Legenden fortæller
programme.desc: I dette afsnit af 'Legenden Fortæller' ser vi tilbage på Bent 'Turbo' Christensen Arensøes målrige karriere i Brøndby IF. Med fem mesterskaber, to pokaltitler og tre topscorertitler skrev han sig ind i historien – både som spiller og træner.

programme.title: Legenden fortæller
programme.desc: I sæsonpremieren af 'Legenden Fortæller' ser vi tilbage på Kim Vilforts 12 år i Brøndby IF – fra præsentationen i 1986 til den sidste kamp i 1998. Hør om de største kampe, titlerne og øjeblikkene, der gjorde ham til en af klubbens største profiler.

programme.title: Holdet - Tæt på
programme.desc: I dette afsnit af 'All Access' kommer du helt tæt på den intense derbysejr og med bag kulisserne til kampen i Aalborg, hvor du oplever stemningen, forberedelserne og øjeblikkene, der definerede to af sæsonens mest nervepirrende opgør.

programme.title: Spillerportrætter
programme.desc: I dette afsnit af 'Spillerportrætter' møder du drengene fra Vestegnen, Clement Bischoff og Noah Nartey. Hør om deres rødder, vejen gennem ungdomsrækkerne og stoltheden ved at spille for Brøndby IF – klubben, de er vokset op med.

programme.title: Legenden fortæller
programme.desc: Morten Wieghorst sætter i dette længere interview ord på sin tid på Vestegnen, som gjorde ham til en helt særlig stikkelse i klubbens historie.

programme.title: Sportsdirektørerne
programme.desc: I første afsnit af Sportsdirektørerne møder vi tre tidligere sportsdirektører i Brøndby IF, der åbent deler deres oplevelser fra livet bag kulisserne i en af Danmarks største fodboldklubber.

programme.title: Vores Brøndby
programme.desc: I sæsonafslutningen af 'Vores Brøndby' hyldes klubben i en kærlighedserklæring. Med Rasmus Hammerich og Kim Vilfort taler panelet om, hvorfor Brøndby betyder så meget – for fans og spillere – og hvad der gør klubben helt særlig.

programme.title: Fokus
programme.desc: I dette afsnit af 'Fokus' fortæller Marko Divkovic om skiftet fra angreb til forsvar, Daniel Wass deler sine tanker om rollen som playmaker, og Jonathan Ægidius giver et indblik i konkurrencen og kampen om pladsen mellem stængerne.

programme.title: Holdet - Tæt på
programme.desc: I dette afsnit af 'Holdet – Tæt på' får du status fra Jesper Sørensen og spillerne Rasmussen, Kvistgaarden, Bischoff og Rajović. Hør deres refleksioner om sæsonen, præstationerne og hvad der venter forude i jagten på succes.

programme.title: Fokus
programme.desc: I dette afsnit af 'Fokus' fortæller Frederik Alves om at gribe chancen, Mathias Kvistgaarden markerer sin milepæl med 50 kampe i gult og blåt, og Rasmus Lauritsen ser tilbage på sin startdebut i Brøndby IF-trøjen.

programme.title: Spørg Løs!
programme.desc: I dette afsnit af 'Spørg Løs!' afslører spillerne deres bedste udebaneminder, yndlingsfilm og hvem der ville vinde Wimbledon – eller Vild med dans. Du får også svar på, hvem der er nemmest at forskrække og mest savnet i vinterpausen.

programme.title: Vores Brøndby
programme.desc: I denne episode af 'Vores Brøndby' dykker et nyt panel med Colding, Kahlenberg og Nanna Møller Karlsen ned i klubbens største kampe. Allan Ravn gæster studiet og fortæller om sit ikoniske mål mod Bayern München og de oplevelser, der har formet Brøndby.

programme.title: Udfordringen
programme.desc: I dette afsnit af 'Udfordringen' dyster spillerne i buzz-ball, fodboldgolf og straffesparkskonkurrence mellem Danmark og Norge. Der er også stil på programmet, og så kæmpes der om æren i “Tættest på midten".

programme.title: Holdet - Tæt på
programme.desc: I dette afsnit af 'Holdet – Tæt på' besøger du spillernes hotel med Mileta Rajović, ser Jordi og Ohi vise rundt i Østrig, oplever Klaiber og Nartey i Portugal – og får et kig ind i villaerne sammen med Kvist og Kevin T.

programme.title: Fraklip
programme.desc: I 'Fraklip fra året der gik' får du de sjoveste øjeblikke fra Brøndby IF, der aldrig nåede skærmen. Grin med, når spillerne snubler i replikkerne, joker bag kulisserne og viser deres menneskelige side fra træningslejre, interviews og hverdagen.
programme.sub-title: Afsnit 1: Fraklip fra året der gik - #1-5

programme.title: Vores Brøndby
programme.desc: I 'Vores Brøndby' får det faste hold besøg af Noah Nartey til en snak om livet som prof i dag vs. 90’erne. De vender krav, mediepres og træningskultur, før ung mod gammel klæder to giner i hjemme- og udebanesæt.

programme.title: Udfordringen
programme.desc: I dette afsnit af 'Udfordringen' skyder spillerne Black Friday-rabatter i No Bounce Challenge, mens Alves, Cappis og Maxsø dyster i tre intense udfordringer. Til sidst gælder det præcision og pres i en klassisk crossbar challenge.

programme.title: Fokus
programme.desc: I dette afsnit af 'Fokus' fortæller Jordi Vanlerberghe om sit første derby, Frederik Birk giver et indblik i rollen som assistenttræner, og Mathias Kvistgaarden markerer en stor milepæl med sine første 100 kampe for Brøndby IF.

programme.title: Vores Brøndby
programme.desc: I 'Vores Brøndby' gæster Nikolaj Koppel og sætter ord på fankulturen: fællesskab, traditioner og hvorfor Brøndby betyder så meget for så mange. Til sidst udfordres han til at spille “Jump” på et virkelig dårligt legetøjskeyboard.

W programie przyjrzymy się sylwetkom łowców bramek i oczywiście najpiękniejszym golom w ich bogatych kolekcjach.
programme.title: Najlepsi napastnicy Bundesligi lat 90

programme.title: Bundesliga Clubs

programme.desc: Mecze Bayernu z Borussią Dortmund od lat nadają ton rywalizacji o mistrzostwo Niemiec. Nie inaczej będzie z Der Klassikerem numer 141, który zostanie rozegrany w ramach ósmej kolejki kampanii 2026/27. Bawarczycy i piłkarze BVB do połowy października szli łeb w łeb w wyścigu o tytuł. Ich bezpośrednie starcie na Allianz Arenie najprawdopodobniej zadecyduje o tym, który z gigantów zostanie samodzielnym liderem Bundesligi. Podopieczni Vincenta Kompany'ego mają nad Dortmundczykami przewagę psychologiczną. Znajdują się bowiem na fali trzech zwycięstw z rzędu nad Borussią. Ostatnim razem pokonali ją 2:1 w sierpniowym meczu o Superpuchar Niemiec.
programme.title: Liga niemiecka - mecz: FC Bayern Monachium - Borussia Dortmund

programme.desc: Rossoneri znaleźli patent na derbowego rywala. Mogą się poszczycić bilansem pięciu wygranych i trzech remisów w ośmiu ostatnich konfrontacjach z Interem. Podrażnieni Nerazzurri mają świadomość, że muszą zrobić wszystko, co w ich mocy, by przerwać błędne koło i odzyskać panowanie w stolicy Lombardii. W hicie dziesiątej kolejki na pewno zmotywuje ich do tego spory ścisk panujący na szczycie tabeli Serie A. Jeśli Piotr Zieliński i spółka nie pokonają Milanu, ucieszą piłkarzy Lazio i Romy, którzy na obecnym etapie sezonu wyglądają na ich głównych konkurentów w wyścigu o scudetto.
programme.title: Liga włoska - mecz: AC Milan - Inter Mediolan

programme.desc: Opowieść o AJ Auxerre. Klub został założony w 1905 roku w niewielkim mieście w Burgundii. Mimo lokalizacji z dala od metropolii przez lata rzucał wyzwanie tuzom francuskiego futbolu. Największy sukces odniósł w 1996 roku, gdy został mistrzem Ligue 1.

programme.title: Fishful Thinking: P.E.I. Bluefin Tuna

programme.title: Fishful Thinking: Slow Death Walleye and Lunkerhunt Goby
programme.desc: An informative episode... first Walleye fishing in the north country. Attention to detail always pay off. Then drop shot rigs for Bass on Lake Erie.

programme.title: Fishful Thinking: New Brunswick Sturgeon
programme.desc: Fishing the St.John area in N.B. for Sturgeon. There are plenty of fish to enjoy but a few tricks, attention to detail and proper boat position can make it even more enjoyable.

programme.title: Fishful Thinking: Big Fish of the Year
programme.desc: A highlight of some of the largest fish caught this year. This is for the viewers who love to see the monsters!!

programme.title: Gone Fishin
programme.desc: Exploring the rugged Paringa River mouth and jet boating the Hall in remote South Westland.

programme.title: Gone Fishin
programme.desc: A relaxing morning of whitebaiting with Sid—classic Kiwi tradition meets underwater spectacle.

programme.title: Gone Fishin
programme.desc: Fishing soft baits and exploring scenic fishing spots around the Cavalli Islands.

programme.title: Gone Fishin
programme.desc: A soft bait masterclass in the Bay of Islands, diving for scallops and a young fisher’s first spear catch.

programme.title: IFISH: Australian Salmon - Port Lincoln, SA
programme.desc: Local knowledge is always best, so when young Archie from Port Lincoln told me we were gonna smash some BIG Australian Salmon off the beach - I knew I was in for one hell of a day!

programme.title: IFISH: Spanish Mackerel - Namotu Island, Fiji
programme.desc: The apple doesn't fall far from the tree. Down rigging big live baits, deep dropping for monsters of the deep and popping for those massive surface strikes - what more could Jet and I ask for!

programme.title: IFISH: Black Bream - Bemm River, VIC
programme.desc: Traditionally bream fishing is a game of bait and wait... well not if Franks around! Local East Gippsland guru, Frank Milito, gives PW a lesson in using vibes for BIG Bemm River bream, that you really must see!

programme.title: IFISH: Sailfish - Darwin, NT
programme.desc: When Paul hears the word "Darwin", two things come to mind - Barra and Crocs! So when PW got invited to fish for sailfish, in 20m of water, he couldn't say no! Get out your note pad and pen, because you're about to learn how you can do it all yourself!

programme.title: IFISH: Barramundi, Horizontal Falls, WA
programme.desc: There is only one thing better than waking up in the remote pristine wilderness of the Kimberley - and that's fishing it! Join the Worsteling tribe as they navigate their way through dense mangrove systems in search of the mighty BARRAMUNDI!

programme.title: IFISH: Yellowtail Kingfish, Jervis Bay, NSW
programme.desc: "Catch the fresh bait, get the BIG fish!" Join the team for a step by step lesson in down rigging fresh baits for big angry Kings!

programme.title: Icelandic Tails: Episode 1
programme.desc: Robson Green, the actor and host of Extreme Fishing TV series is our guest. He has never fished for Icelandic salmon. We travel to the remote pools of Kjarrá by helicopter and fish pools that are untouched the whole summer.

programme.title: Icelandic Tails: Episode 2
programme.desc: Charles and Alex Jardine travel to the highlands of Iceland looking for monster arctic char. Charles Jardine is a respected artist who specializes in painting fish and fisherman. The river they fish is a gin clear river, home to some huge trout.

programme.title: Icelandic Tails: Episode 3
programme.desc: Tiggy Pettifer, a passionate angler, is visiting Iceland. She is a well known personality in the UK being a former employee of the royal family. Tiggy gos to lake Thingvallavatn and looks for the Ice age brown trout that the lake is famous for.

programme.title: Icelandic Tails: Episode 4
programme.desc: The 93 year old Lilla Rowcliffe is coming to Iceland for the 30th time. Fishing the same river. Big Laxá. She brings along her grandson and great grandson that is 11 years old. Lilla has had an astonishing live and shares a bit of that live with us.

programme.title: Icelandic Tails: Episode 5
programme.desc: Mother and daughter fish both river Vídidalsá and river Midfjardará. The mother Joanna Gibson is taken along with her daughter Marina Gibson who is a highly skilled fisherman and runs her own very successful fly fishing school in Europe.

programme.title: Icelandic Tails: Episode 6
programme.desc: Robson Green is back with a friend and a colleague. Actor James Murray joins him for an adventure in Iceland. Fishing Laxá in Asum, or just Asum the two give a great performance in this famous river. Competition is on.
